notes: Checks from the contract's table (engine/sfx.md#spike-testsenginesfx, Technical Director 2026-10-02), with the contract's limits. Built and measured by the raster-engineer in M4 stage 4 (2026-10-02: engine/sfx.md#results, tests/engine/sfx/measure.py and measure_results.txt). The limits are still the contract's estimates-with-room: every path below is constant and DMA-free (sfx_update from line 251, sfx_play in the top border, no IRQ inside), so each can become a lock (min_cycles = max_cycles) at its measured figure, which each check's source gives; setting the locks is the Technical Director's. The spike runs an 80-frame phase cycle (main.asm's header): 21 idle ticks, 39 slide ticks and 1 three-start tick a cycle, sfx_play's take path 5 times and its replace and keep paths once each; warmup_frames covers one whole cycle. The spans of the first three and the last three profile checks are a jsr to the label after it: WHOLE CALLS (profile span + jsr 6 + rts 6: engine/README.md#which-span-a-figure-is). Behaviour is check.py (the last check): the module against an independent model, every SID register write, every frame. Schema: engine/README.md#budget-files.
